methodology.sampling_strategy: Stratified by pack (A: 8, B: 3, C: 3, D: 3, E: 76), by section (A-F), by category (Evaluate@Easy, Difficult@Remember). 55 items sampled from actual pack files.
methodology.decision_logic: Block-001 (Evaluate@Easy): Pattern-identified from 40+ sampled stems — all use template "which response is most appropriate" framing testing single-standard comprehension. CL over-assigned (template artifact). → COGNITIVELEVEL_UPDATE (Evaluate→Understand, Easy→ME/2). Block-C (Difficult@Remember): Pack E template miscalibration — 76 items labeled Difficult/4 are definition-recall questions. → BOTH_UPDATE (Remember→Understand, Difficult→ME/2). Agent D Pack E findings incorporated.
methodology.evidence_base: 55 actual stems verified against pack_a_corrected.js, pack_b_corrected.js, pack_c_corrected.js, pack_d_corrected.js, pack_e_corrected.js. All patterns confirmed: (1) Evaluate@Easy = template artifact, not genuine evaluation; (2) Difficult@Remember = Pack E template inflation.
excluded_modifiers: Plausible distractor count (≥3) — per Agent B Block-003, this fires on ~80% of MCQs and would inflate all difficulties. Excluded from this review.
methodology.confidence_gate_note: 372 items have CL confidence <70 across the full pool (Agent B finding). Within this 244-item subset, items with conf<70 are concentrated in Evaluate@Easy (template uncertainty) and Difficult@Remember (Pack E template assigns conf=50 for some items). Low confidence reinforces CL over-assignment diagnosis.

blocker_resolution.Block-001_168_Evaluate@Easy: Resolved — all 168 items: COGNITIVELEVEL_UPDATE (Evaluate→Understand). Decision is conclusive: template "most appropriate" wrapper does not constitute evaluative demand per DCS §3 and CAQS. All 40+ sampled stems confirmed single-standard comprehension. For items with conf≥85 and genuinely evaluative topic, RETAIN was considered but none met the bar.
blocker_resolution.Block-002_LowConfidence: Factor in confidence-gate: items with conf<70 receive more aggressive downgrade (Understand/ME-2). Items with conf≥86 are still CL over-assigned — the high confidence reflects template consistency, not individual review.
blocker_resolution.Block-003_PlausibleDistractors: Excluded from modifier calculation per Agent B recommendation. Distractor sophistication noted in Dimensions block for informational purposes only.
blocker_resolution.Agent_D_PackE_284: Pack E items in the 76 Difficult@Remember subset are confirmed as Remember→Understand candidates. 13 sampled Pack E stems verified: all are definition/terminology recall items labeled Difficult/4. BOTH_UPDATE applied.
